title: agrostemma githago var. macrospermum
intro: Agrostemma githago var. macrospermum, commonly known as Corn Cockle, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. The plant is known to possess various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include being used as a demulcent, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents present in Corn Cockle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
